name: euglena Co., Ltd.
summary: Euglena Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of microalgae. The company also manufactures and sells foods and cosmetics using euglena. It offers green juices, cookie bars, beverages, dietary supplements, and raw materials, as well as contract manufacturing/processing services. In addition, it develops biofuel technology and environmental related technology for microalgae; and invests in bio-tech related business. The company distributes Drinking Midorimushi beverages at supermarkets and convenience stores. Euglena Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
